title: Eglin AFB NICoE Mechanical Controls
scope: Complete ground truth for the supplied 24-page Eglin AFB NICoE mechanical and controls set: all pages reviewed; project/sheet/scale context; all 132 literal schedule marks across M7.1-M7.3; a full 58-row, 18-field VAV performance table; 158 dual-engine-checked BAS point-function rows across M8.3/M8.4/M8.5/M8.7/M8.8; M8.2 network architecture; M8.3-M8.8 sequences; sensor/thermostat mapping; and explicit limitations. The record does not fabricate plan-placement, installed device, controller terminal/card, control-valve or damper-actuator quantities/specifications not published by the source.
reading_notes: Every supplied page has a retained full-page Poppler render and visual disposition. Authoritative strict schedule and point cells are rechecked against both retained MuPDF and Poppler captures during every build/verify run.
The schedule registry contains 132 unique marks: 25 M7.1, 49 M7.2 and 58 M7.3. The companion M7.3 table preserves each VAV's 18 source performance fields (1,044 independently rechecked cells).

The BAS ledger contains 158 literal M8 point-function rows: 21 chilled-water, 32 heating-hot-water, 69 AHU-1, 15 VAV and 21 miscellaneous. Categories are printed AI/DI/AO/DO template columns, not final installed I/O quantities.

M8.2 explicitly identifies two MSTP VAV trunks and a dedicated VFD MSTP trunk. It also identifies Ethernet/Cat-6 and RS-485/RS-232 media; it does not establish an IP/BACnet-instance or final panel/card/terminal design.

The record preserves valve/damper control behavior but records the absence of a tabular control-valve or damper-actuator schedule rather than inventing Cv, actuator, signal, fail-position or quantity data.

requirement_audit.finding: The project/facility name, Ash Dr Eglin AFB Florida address, SmithGroup/SmithGroup MEP-FP, issue, dates and project number are retained as printed.
All 24 supplied pages have a completed sheet disposition and retained full-page review image; schedule and controls sheet titles are additionally bounded in metadata.
The observed 1/8, 1/4 and 1-1/2 inch view scales are retained; no document-wide scale or nonexistent graphic scale bar is invented.
Every M7.1-M7.3 schedule mark is source-classified/anchored, with untagged coil types and non-instance air-device schedule types explicitly scoped.
The schedule registry covers 132 literal marks, and a 58-row VAV companion preserves all 18 printed performance fields per VAV source row.
All 158 cell-bounded source rows retain system/template ownership and printed AI/DI/AO/DO category; repeated tags stay source-row scoped.
Network controllers, gateways/media, two VAV MSTP trunks and a dedicated VFD MSTP trunk are preserved with explicit unavailable topology/addressing fields.
Chilled-water, heating-hot-water, AHU, VAV and miscellaneous sequence/diagram contexts are summarized under their source sheets.
Temperature, humidity, pressure, CO2, flow, thermostat and leak-sensor mappings retain template scope, including the stated minimum of three AHU space-pressure sensors.
Point-card quantities, network configuration, valve/actuator schedules and facility-wide sensor counts are explicitly constrained to what the source provides.
Every one of 24 supplied pages is represented once with a completed review finding and retained full-page render.
Build/verify independently rechecks all authored literal schedule/point/assertion evidence against retained MuPDF and Poppler captures and hashes all modules/renders.

page_review.finding: M0.1 mechanical abbreviations, plan symbols, HVAC/piping legend and general notes.
M2.1 HVAC zone legend locating VAV, DX and FCU zone designations; not used as an unverified symbol count.
M2.2 ground-floor air-terminal plan with terminal marks and CFM callouts.
M2.3 ground-floor duct plan with VAV, FCU, exhaust and louver context plus room schedule.
M2.4 roof plan locating air-cooled condensing units, louvers and exhaust fans.
M3.1 ground-floor HVAC piping plan and utility-yard chiller context.
M4.1 enlarged mechanical-room duct and piping plans locating AHU-1, B-1/B-2, pumps, tanks and separators.
M4.2 mechanical-room sections with AHU, boilers, piping and roof equipment relationships.
M5.1 hot-water and chilled-water piping diagrams connecting boilers, chiller, pumps, tanks, separators and AHU coils.
M6.1 mechanical piping details including 2-way/3-way coil valves, air separator, tank, chiller, pump and unit-heater details.
M6.2 ductwork details including volume dampers, roof ventilator, VAV terminal connections and branch takeoffs.
M6.3 equipment details including buffer tank, boiler cool-down and base-mounted pump.
M6.4 AHU views/elevation showing coils, energy wheel, MERV 8/MERV 14 filters, fans and motorized-control-damper context.
M7.1 primary AHU, fan, coil, chiller, boiler, pump, general-fan and air-separator schedules.
M7.2 air-device, FCU, condensing-unit, expansion-tank, DX fan-coil, unit-heater, silencer, radiator and louver schedules.
M7.3 dense VAV box schedule containing VAV-1 through VAV-58.
M8.1 controls abbreviations, symbols and BAS-point semantics including AI/DI/AO/DO definitions and failure-mode meanings.
M8.2 system architecture: B-BC-1/B-BC-2/B-BC-3, B-ASC, network gateway, two MSTP VAV trunks and dedicated VFD MSTP trunk.
M8.3 chilled-water control diagram, written sequence and point function schedule.
M8.4 heating-hot-water control diagram, written boiler/pump sequence and point function schedule.
M8.5 AHU-1 control diagram, point function schedule, occupancy schedule, balancing diagram and global HVAC-zone/space-pressure points.
M8.6 AHU-1 written sequence of operation, diagnostics and direct VFD interface requirements.
M8.7 constant-air-volume, dual-maximum VAV and VAV diagrams/sequences with a VAV point function schedule.
M8.8 toilet/mechanical-room exhaust, unit-heater, fan-coil, lighting, radiator, DX, emergency-shutdown and drain-pan sequences plus miscellaneous point schedule.

verification_semantics: MuPDF and Poppler independently captured all 24 supplied vector-PDF pages. Every authored strict schedule mark, every M7.3 performance cell, every M8 point-function cell and each bounded text witness is rechecked against both engines at build and validation time; full-page Poppler review establishes visible page context. These checks corroborate literal source content and declared bounds, not physical plan quantities or unprovided controller, network, valve, actuator, terminal, wiring, location or device-multiplier details.
